purpose: Prevent same-source repetition or parser agreement from being mistaken for independent fact verification.

requirements: provider is organizationally independent from the issuer
assurance scope explicitly covers the metric, entity, period and boundary
assurance level and standard are recorded
dataset has its own provenance and methodology
entity, metric, period, unit and boundary are explicitly mappable
record version or retrieval timestamp and content hash are frozen

ineligible_as_independent: a second parser applied to the same issuer PDF
another issuer-controlled page repeating the same disclosure
search snippets or unsaved web summaries
a value inferred only from a chart without frozen coordinates and method
